text:
Eli: quick thought  what if we call the DP flow "sandwich onboarding": small focused pilots (top slice) -> broad wave (filling) -> ongoing nurture (bottom slice). goal: fast learning, then scale.
Maya: neat metaphor. recommend 3 checkpoints: tech health, usage signals, partner sentiment. all must pass to move from top slice -> filling.
Sam: what are concrete thresholds? metrics please.
Maya: propose: tech health = errors <1% and p95 <400ms; usage = >=3 distinct happy paths/week; sentiment = AE thumbs-up or score >=4/5.
Priya: add: require 8 canonical prompts per partner for blind rollout checks. also suggest small incentive: $250 credits + product-team demo slot for successful pilots.
Jonah: ops: need instant rollback for any partner showing regression. plan: per-partner feature-flag + automated fallback + page oncall.
Eli: outreach language: call the pilot a "two-week focused run" with clear expectations and migration checklist. lowers surprises.
Sam: schedule: week0 invites (6), week2 review, week4 open wave (20-30), week8 evaluate scale. can compress if infra pre-cleared.
Priya: feedback channels: weekly 30m syncs during pilot, short post-flow micro-surveys, and a single shared doc for logs.
Maya: gating automation: make gate machine-readable (JSON-esque) so eng-dashboard can auto-eval. also block rollout if partner blind-eval delta >3 pts.
Jonah: I'll draft the fallback runbook and flag automation draft by Friday.
Sam: I'll produce the invite list and recurring calendar invites. tagging @deploy-bot to create the event template.
deploy-bot: created "DP Sandwich Pilot Check-in (30m)" series and invited Eli, Maya, Sam, Priya, Jonah. :calendar:
Maya: decision on NDA? recommend no NDA for early pilots to reduce friction; require lightweight feedback consent.
Eli: actions:
- Maya: publish gating matrix (Thu EOD)
- Priya: outreach copy + incentives + micro-survey (Mon)
- Jonah: fallback/runbook draft (Fri)
- Sam: invite list + calendar (Tue)
Maya: we'll close once matrix is posted. thanks all. :raised_hands:
